device_entry.name: 实验室板式振荡器
tags: 微孔板样品孵育与混匀
device_entry.description: 用于对实验样品板进行振荡混匀的实验室设备，可按设定转速运行指定时长或连续运行，并支持锁定/解锁样品板以保证振荡过程中的稳定性。
device_entry.description_en: A laboratory device used to shake and mix sample plates. It can run at a specified speed for a set duration or continuously, and supports locking/unlocking the plate to keep it secure during shaking.
